A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world…
for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and…

Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
